svg.title: ENv6 base board block diagram
svg.desc: The RP2354B connects to the ENv6 connector (SPI1, JTAG, configuration lines, GPIOs, I2C0, detection), to USB, WLAN radio, microSD and debug. USB-C feeds a BQ25188 charger, an LP873300 supply with four rails passes through the PAC1954 current sensor to the power header.
